data.summary:
Have 9+ years of overall IT experience working at Tata Consultancy Services as Senior Business Analyst in Production Application maintenance and support projects for Avaloq Banking Suite. Primary expertise in Avaloq trading wealth management system under Banking and Financial Services domain.
With recent 6 years of client facing onsite (Sydney, Australia) extensive expertise in Global Wealth Management, my role as a Senior Business Analyst has been pivotal in driving key initiatives. Contributing to a top-ranked global Australian bank (Westpac Bank), our team managed intricate Incident, Problem and Change management activities, ensuring SLAs were consistently met.
Leveraging my skills in Business Analysis, Data Analysis, Avaloq wealth, IT Service Management, ITIL, Microsoft Power BI, ServiceNow, Microsoft Excel, SQL, and Microsoft Power Automate, we've achieved significant savings and enhanced operational efficiency.
My commitment lies in developing reliable solutions that surpass client expectations, and I thrive on the challenges presented in coordinating with various stakeholders to facilitate successful project outcomes.

raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst - Avaloq Wealth
Tata Consultancy Services
02/2023 – 08/2025
Sydney, NSW, Australia
​Served as a key Business Analyst at Australia's largest wealth management fund administration platform (BT Panorama) by analysing business requirements, coordinating with Developers and business Stakeholders for Data analysis and supporting the critical Avaloq Banking Suite wealth application.
​Expertise in Avaloq trading platform functionalities and workflows, skilled in SQL, with hand- on experience with Avaloq's underlying databases (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle)
​Led Panorama Year End statement migration project activities for consecutive three Financial Years to ensure smooth delivery of client statements to a large base of respective account holders within agreed business legislative timelines.
​Business analyst expertise in Australian Year-End programs, Tax, Accounting processes, Superannuation and Trading technology with a knack for innovative problem solving and effective resolution implementation.
​Continuously driven enhancements and automations to streamline production support processes and reduce the manual TOIL efforts.
​Strong communication skills - both written and verbal, complemented by exceptional interpersonal abilities and analytical thinking, ensuing prominent solution delivery.
​Recognised by client partner head offs for outshining performance and contribution to the Avaloq Production support projects.
​Recognised by business for being the responsible and trusted associate in handling production issues related to Panorama Year End statements project.
Service Management Level 1 Team Lead
Tata Consultancy Services
01/2020 – 01/2023
Sydney, NSW, Australia
​Providing 24/7 escalation of Production service interruptions, Changes, Incidents, Problems, and corrective actions, as well as coordinating the recovery of service interruptions, including associated changes.
​Worked closely with Major Incident Management Team and coordinated with relevant Stake Holders to run Post-Incident Reviews.
​Continually evaluate trends for improving operational processes and practices across Incident and Problem ITIL disciplines.
​Drive change, team motivation, process reviews, and performance management by setting an example.
​Automated multiple reports using reporting tools like Microsoft Power BI, ServiceNow, Tableau, Xtraction & Microsoft Excel and took over responsibility for incident management and request fulfilment for the IT Service Desk.
​Ensure consistency in IT Service Delivery across all areas by managing and communicating with various stakeholders.
​Developed, documented, supported as well as executed processes regarding interfaces, interaction and responsibilities between Level 1 Support associate, Level 2 Support associate and any other internal or external associates or entities that may either lodge an incident or receive it.
​Expertise in IT Service Management and Delivery, as well as understanding of operational disciplines in ITIL framework.
IT Support Analyst Level 2
Tata Consultancy Services
05/2018 – 12/2019
Pune, Maharashtra, India
​Production support monitoring of application and addressing the issues reported for the transactions flowing through Cognos TM1, Juno, Axiom reporting and Tableau.
​Performed regular and timely system and server health checks to ensure 24x7 application availability in Production.
​Incident, Problem, and Change Management using BMC Remedy and ServiceNow following the ITIL practices.
​Performed Disaster Recovery activity using Archer and regular Cognos TM1 service restart activity to ensure everything is up and running as part of Business Continuity Plan (BCP).
​Regular clean-ups and housekeeping activities are done as TM1 administrator and servers to ensure hassle-free service.
IT Support Analyst Level 1
Tata Consultancy Services
11/2016 – 04/2017
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
​Worked as Software UI developer for a User Management and Task management Internal project which helps users to maintain and track allocated tasks.
​Requirement analysis and data analysis.
​Debugging and bug fixation.
​Handling support incidents raised by internal users.
​Document Preparation and management.
​Performing unit testing and integration testing to ensure stability of the product.
​Providing efficient and effective solutions for the issues rose.
​Code management and providing solutions for versioning management.
System Engineer
Tata Consultancy Services
08/2016 – 10/2016
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
​TCS initial learning program includes induction about organization along with technical trainings on skills, language and area of Mapping of project.
​Learned skills on designing screens and managing sub file views using mainframe tools AS400, RPG Language Enhanced, CLP and CLLE (Control Language with Language Extension).
​Requirement analysis and data analysis.
​Debugging and bug fixation.
​Product stability testing.
